text: Maple Invest Co Limited is wholly owned, via DICO International Projects Company Limited (both British Virgin Islands companies), by 'the Ultimate Offeror' -- whom its own regulator-filed Offer Document identifies as 'the founder of DAMAC, Mr. Hussain Sajwani.' Sajwani's Maple Invest vehicle acquired DAMAC Properties' remaining public shares in a 2021-22 tender offer, and DAMAC stopped trading on the Dubai Financial Market in February 2022 before converting to a private company; no Dubai state shareholding is named.

source.name: Maple Invest Co Limited, Amended Offer Document (filed with the UAE Securities and Commodities Authority / Nasdaq Dubai)
source.quote: The Ultimate Offeror is the founder of DAMAC, Mr. Hussain Sajwani.
